description: BEFORE merging, scan the resolved lockfile. Checking the packages someone chose misses the transitive ones nobody did — which is usually where the risk is. Pass the file contents (package-lock.json, requirements.txt, uv.lock, go.sum, Cargo.lock, a CycloneDX SBOM, …). Returns `agent_action`: REFUSE means do not merge.

filename.description: e.g. 'package-lock.json' — the format is detected from it

path.description: Local runs only (uvx vdb-mcp): read the file here instead of passing content.

name: vdb_scan_lockfile
